title: Repair truthful causal completeness for Paper rejection and no-trade journeys

candidate_f6_failure_evidence.failure_message: Trade Journey was not formal complete truth

after_restore_e9_readback_diagnosis.why_risk_evaluation_was_missing: paper_runtime.py emitted a separate risk_evaluation telemetry event only for committed_fill and canonical_lifecycle, while pre-broker order_rejection (sell_without_holdings) and explicit no-trade paper_order_simulated mapped directly to order_submission (index 9 of STAGES). Because risk_evaluation (index 8 of STAGES) is an observable stage before order_submission, JourneyMaterializer._missing_stages and TradeJourneyProjectionStore._projection_from_journey included risk_evaluation in completeness.missing_stages, causing trade_journeys._read_state to downgrade both detail and list surfaces from formal to partial.

repair_summary.paper_runtime: Stamps truthful risk_status=rejected, risk_reason=sell_without_holdings, risk_decision_id, requested_quantity, and holding_quantity only on bounded pre-broker sell_without_holdings guard rejections and risk_status=skipped on explicit no-trade paper_order_simulated events without fabricating risk evaluations for malformed input, non-finite broker fills, or transport errors.
repair_summary.lifecycle_projector: Propagates bounded sell_without_holdings rejection facts (reason_code=sell_without_holdings, risk_status=rejected, submitted_to_broker=false, quantity=0.0, requested_quantity, holding_quantity) and trusted explicit NoTrade facts (decision_status=no_order, order_status=not_submitted, risk_status=skipped, reason_code, submitted_to_broker=false) while preserving all contradictory broker_order_id/fill_id/broker_trade_id/ledger_entry_id/reconciliation_id identifiers, broker submission flags, non-zero fill quantities, and invalid quantities across all projected stage events without stripping identifiers or inferring risk denial/skip on contradictory, transport, or bare rejections.
repair_summary.materializer: Enforces universal no-fill, no-broker, and zero-quantity guards across all journey events (including nested metadata/metrics) before either skipped-decision or explicit-terminal inference, recording truthful risk_evaluation stage coverage (rejected only for bounded pre-broker sell_without_holdings guard rejections with zero fill quantity and no broker submission; skipped only for verified paper_order_simulated NoTrade skips with zero fill quantity and no broker submission) when required upstream signal_generation and trade_decision stages are present and no post-submission stages, invalid quantities, or broker/fill/ledger/reconciliation identifiers exist.
repair_summary.bff_trade_journeys: Enforces universal no-fill, no-broker, and zero-quantity guards across all timeline events (including nested metadata/metrics) before either skipped-decision or explicit-terminal normalization across detail, list, timeline, graph, and evidence surfaces (including already-persisted journeys rows); contradictory non-zero or invalid quantities, broker/fill/ledger/reconciliation identifiers, broker-submitted flags, empty timelines, missing upstream decisions, transport failures, and unverified order failures remain partial.
